Proposed demo windows (JST):
- Option A: Tue Jul 9, 09:00–09:45 JST
- Option B: Wed Jul 10, 14:00–14:45 JST

Also we need an updated license inventory attached to the calendar invite. I’ll circulate the draft agenda and a recording fallback plan (lighter model variant) once we pick a time.

If any of the above windows are hard for you, flag a preferred time and we’ll try to accommodate.

Thanks —

Folks —

Akira confirmed Jul 9 09:00 JST (Option A) and Tomo is sorting LOA vs PO. Two action items before I send the calendar invite: 

1) License inventory: I attached the existing license_inventory.xlsx to this thread (version in Drive is a week old). Can someone confirm seat counts and which trial keys we can hand over? We only want to give a scoped trial (10 seats max).

2) Backstop capacity: if hosted capacity gets noisy at demo time we should route the session to Dedicated (reserved) or fall back to the lighter 'redwood-slim-quant' variant for the live demo. Vivek — can you confirm Dedicated availability for Jul 9 08:45–10:00 JST and whether switching model variant will be seamless for a short live session?

Kimberly — once Vivek confirms, please draft the invite with attached agenda and a one-line LOA template for Tomo. I’ll include the recording retention policy (30 days internal).

Thanks — Priya

Subject: Re: Internal: quick ops check for Kyoto demo (Jul 9 preferred)

Priya —

Confirmed: we can reserve a small Dedicated pool slot for Jul 9 08:45–10:00 JST (request placed against DEV-DEDICATED-12). Switching to the 'redwood-slim-quant' model is supported; there will be a ~300ms per-token delta but the UI and streaming path are identical, so it’s safe for demos. I’ll pre-stage the model variant and place a sticky reservation so we can flip at the start of the demo if we see increased latency.

Technical caveats: if the customer requests long-generation (>1k tokens) we’ll need to toggle batching rules; we should keep examples to under 600 tokens for the live demo. Also: recording retention window defaults to 30 days for hosted demos; if Kyoto needs longer we’ll need a short contract addendum.

Link to the Dedicated slot reservation: https://redwood.internal/ops/reservations/DEV-DEDICATED-12

Vivek
